title: Interpolation Using Prelookup
text: Use precalculated index and fraction values to accelerate approximation of N-dimensional function, 8 inputs, 1 output, direct feedthrough, {Interpolation method} sets Select Linear; {Number of dimensions} sets the number of table data dimensions, {Require index and fraction as bus} sets the index and fraction inputs can be combined, {Specification} sets how to enter table data, {Source}, {Value} sets the table data values sqrt, {Name}, {Extrapolation method} sets the method of handling input that falls outside the range of the breakpoint data set, {Valid index input may reach last index} allows inputs to access the last elements of table, {Assume index is within range} sets the option to check for out-of-range index, {Diagnostic for out-of-range input} sets the block action when input is out of range, {Number of sub-table selection dimensions} sets the number of dimensions of the output computation, {Sample time (-1 for inherited)} sets the interval between samples, {Table data} sets the data type of table values, {Table minimum} sets the minimum value of table data, {Table maximum} sets the maximum value of table data, {Intermediate results} sets the data type of intermediate results, {Output}, {Output minimum} sets the minimum value the block can output, {Output maximum} sets the maximum value the block can output, {Internal rule priority} sets the internal rule for intermediate calculations, {Lock data type settings against changes by the fixed-point tools} prevents fixed-point tools from overriding data, {Integer rounding mode} sets the rounding mode for fixed-point operations and {Saturate on integer overflow} sets the method of overflow action. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Number of dimensions
params.values: Number of table data dimensions 2 (default) | integer between 1 and 30

params.name: Require index and fraction as bus
